name: warding bond
lore:
# Warding Bond: The Shared Burden

To cast *Warding Bond* is to weave one's very life-force into a protective shroud for another. As the incantation concludes, a translucent, golden tether manifests between the caster and their ward—visible only for a fleeting heartbeat before fading into a low, spectral hum.

The sensation is one of profound, heavy resonance. The caster feels their soul expand, as if their marrow has become a conduit for another’s vitality. When the ward is struck, the pain does not arrive as a sharp sting, but as a dull, sympathetic ache that blooms across the caster’s own skin. It is the magic of the bridge; one cannot protect without also enduring.

Scholars trace this rite to the **Siege of Oakhaven**. Legend tells of the priestess Elara, who bound her spirit to a young scout sent to pierce the enemy lines. Though the scout survived a dozen arrow wounds to deliver his warning, Elara was later found unmarked but breathless, her heart having spent its final beats to sustain his. It remains a magic of ultimate empathy—and terrible cost.
